name: LATERAL PLANK WALK
introduce: Start in a straight arm plank position with your hands underneath your shoulders. \n\nWalk your hands and feet to the left at the same time. Take a few steps to the left, then a few steps to the right. Repeat the exercise.

tips.text: Please perform it on a mat.
Don\'t sink or raise your hips.
You should feel your abdominals burning, maybe even shivering.
This exercise works your core, deltoids and shoulders.
